title: Khaman Dhokla
description: Spongy, lemony steamed besan cakes finished with a mustard and sesame tempering, a classic Gujarati breakfast and tea-time bite.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.notes: 1 tbsp for the batter and 2 tbsp for tempering

steps: Whisk 150 g of besan with the water, sugar, lemon juice, salt, turmeric powder and 1 tbsp of the oil into a smooth, lump-free batter and rest it for 5 minutes.
Grease a steaming plate and bring water to a boil in a steamer or large pot.
Sprinkle the 1 tsp of Eno over the batter, pour in a spoon of water over it, and stir gently just until it foams up.
Pour the batter into the greased plate straight away and steam covered on high heat for 15 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool for a few minutes, then cut into squares.
Heat the remaining 2 tbsp of oil, crackle the mustard seeds and sesame seeds, then add green chilli and curry leaves and pour this over the dhokla.
Garnish with coriander leaves and grated coconut.
